notes.title: Minor Patch - Tower Speedrun Timer
notes.notes: [p]Hi Everyone,[/p][p]First off, a HUGE congratulations to [url="https://www.speedrun.com/Get_to_Work/runs/yd4jj8vy"]Brandwagen who beat the tower in an impressive 6 hours[/url] after launch to win The Doinkler Special Competition.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tower Adjustments[/h3][p]We've made some minor adjustments to the tower (mostly fixing geometry where players were getting soft locked). The tower remains mostly the same, and most players shouldn't notice the changes.[/p][p][/p][h3]Speedrun timer[/h3][p] The Speedrun Community has requested we add a timer for the Doinkler Special, and as such, we've added a timer that is based on height! [/p][p][/p][h3]Quality settings[/h3][p]We've added 3 quality settings (Low, Medium, High). These give very minor improvements to performance, but for those struggling to get good framerates in the main game, this should help a bit![/p][p][/p][h3]Other Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the attempt counter would reset when opening level select multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "The Doinkler Special Competition" button in the title screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone for your support![/p][p]Happy Climbing[/p][p]Stephen & The Isto Team[/p]

notes.title: NEW DLC - The Doinkler Portfolio
notes.notes:
[p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2706170/view/533228283922223289"]Rules for the $500 Competition[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zKYYN4IKWDQ"]Watch the Vlog[/url][/p][hr][/hr][h3]We are so excited to announce our massive (free) DLC, The Doinkler Portfolio![/h3][p]With new gameplay elements, two new game modes and a superstar cast of streamers to voice in a brand new story that follows Richard Bankman as he attempts to take on The Doinkler Portfolio.[/p][h1]The Doinkler Portfolio[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/b178abf530952352aaab27e641a4b406ab507a3e.png"][/img][/p][p]Unlike the main game, we wanted players to experience the game in a less "punishing" way and enjoy the controls and movement, which is why we built individual levels![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/3d0255924de4387c2c495471ae9d81e3f4265312.png"][/img]With a restart button! [/p][p]For the main game, we really had to tone down the difficulty of the jumps, because of how brutal the falls were, but with a restart button, you can instantly retry and learn how to properly hit the obstacles without having to climb all the way back up.[/p][p]Which means, we were able to bump the difficulty up by like…. 300%. [/p][p]Some of the levels are HARD. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/2213f377514eaa125f0423360ab0e7c4cec8fdae.png"][/img]But don't worry, you can skip ahead if you get stuck and play the first level of each world.[/p][p][/p][h2]A New UI[/h2][p]Compare your best times (or number of attempts) with your friends![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/d56892d501cfc261e88fb3bda3a9aa5f2ced755b.png"][/img][/p][p]Across 62 new levels, with a ton of new mechanics and variety of challenges! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/bf6710c4e0be57e583c92e49f1f39ae985cc2160.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/5387abb9fcd2a60926b68f46b322136a051d8f31.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Story[/h2][p]After the initial release, we got such an overwhelmingly positive response to the story, that we just couldn't help ourselves.... and wrote an entirely new story (that has just as much narrative as the main game)[/p][p]And with the help of some of our favorite streamers to voice in the game, you'll be able to experience the story of Richard Bankman as he takes on The Doinkler Portfolio![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/caa231bfb71fc31e5d5fd6217e2726366836b7e4.png"][/img][/p][p]But that's not all! We decided to keep going and add a SECOND game mode. Introducing...[/p][p][/p][h1]The Doinkler Special[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/86ddbec61a1ab68ca06fe14823472ca49c7727dd.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the Doinkler Special, a giant tower that uses most of the pieces from The Doinkler Portfolio, but removes all of the forgiveness of the restart button, because we figured, if you fall, you can always practice in The Doinkler Portfolio and then come back.[/p][p]We really wanted to challenge the most hardcore players and because of that, there's way less recovery[/p][p](Don't get me wrong, there's still some, we're not animals). Everyone will still be able to make some progress but the further you go up, the less recovery there is. 
[/p][h2]
Performance[/h2][p]You'll also notice that we're using this basic prototype texture all throughout the tower, and there's a reason for this - The DLC is free. [/p][p]But more importantly, the tower is way more performant because we don't have to load textures, and more importantly baked lightmaps. The tower runs faster than the main game, with no loading hitches despite having way longer sightlines.[/p][p]Most big tower rage games just have stuff pop in and out, but I think we've done a good job of optimizing it to look seamless.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/9ab466ba6dbed39527f07387212dbdf1abf30411.png"][/img][/p][h2]
Steam Leaderboards [/h2][p]Since this level was made to be nearly impossible, we figured it'd be more fun to see how far you can get, and rub it in your friends' faces.[/p][p]So with steam leaderboard integration, you can compare both in the main menu and in the world how far you and your friends have gotten. [/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/caf4bbc9e4b1f61f853abe1eacf27a0202738a86.png"][/img]The Doinkler Special Challenge[/h2][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2706170/view/533228283922223289"]Link to the Rules[/url][/p][p]And of course, we want to build some hype for the DLC, so we're excited to announce, The Doinkler Special Challenge - A $500 dollar cash prize for the first person to complete the entire tower from start to finish live on stream.[/p][p]If you're curious, click the link above to learn more [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/803641317596fdf5bfc26c1158db785cc79ee723.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, a huge thank you to everyone who has played the game, and continues to support our small indie team.[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck and have fun![/p][p]Stephen & The Isto Inc Team[/p]

notes.title: The Doinkler Portfolio Is Coming July 14
notes.notes:
[p][url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ewz40CIxnVv3WQSjiP_2y3O4PWJDq2DOw8A-8lbDZpE/edit?usp=sharing"]Unofficial Leaderboard[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]Players were asking us for individual levels, and we have delivered! [/p][p]This FREE DLC follows Richard Bankman, a middle manager tasked with trying to make the impossible financial investment portfolio - "The Doinkler Portfolio" profitable. [/p][p]We'll be posting more details on launch date and you can learn more about it In our Vlog:[/p][p]But the focus of this post is to let players know about:[/p][h1]The Doinkler Special Competition - RULES[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/803641317596fdf5bfc26c1158db785cc79ee723.png"][/img][/p][p]Tell your friends! The competition starts when the DLC launches on Monday, July 14 @ 11 am MST (6 pm UTC)[/p][p]I've covered the basic details [url="https://youtu.be/zKYYN4IKWDQ?si=U4XEdaBLFFaa2zZQ&t=1105"]here[/url][/p][p]But i wanted to spell out the rules in much finer detail well in advance.[/p][p][/p][h2]Rules:[/h2][olist][*][p]All gameplay must be done live[/p][/*][*][p]The entire run must be available to watch after completing the tower[/p][p]e.g. Twitch deletes VOD's after 14 days, so make sure to save and upload them if the competition takes longer than 2 weeks![/p][/*][*][p]The game can be streamed on any platform (Twitch, YouTube) but the Isto Team must be able to view it[/p][/*][*][p]If you beat the tower, please show the time live on stream (Twitch does a horrible job of time stamping and this helps us verify in case there is a tie)[/p][list][*][p]We recommend this link:  [url="https://24timezones.com/time-zone/mt"]https://24timezones.com/time-zone/mt[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h3]What is Not Allowed[/h3][list][*][p]No save scumming[/p][/*][*][p]No mods[/p][list][*][p]This includes the practice mod. [/p][list][*][p]We are hoping players can discover the tower organically (rather than flying straight to the top as soon as it comes out). We obviously can't monitor if you use practice mods offline, but we would encourage you do not.[/p][/*][*][p]The Doinkler Portfolio is designed to let you practice the elements, so using a practice mod should not give players a distinct advantage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]No changing FPS outside of the game[/p][list][*][p]You can play the game with an uncapped FPS (vsync off) or locked at 60fps (vysnc on)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]No slowing down the game[/p][/*][*][p]No manipulating the timer[/p][/*][*][p]No machine assist[/p][list][*][p]i.e. TAS and auto spam programs (or programs that help you auto spam outside of what we intended)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]No egregious exploits that skip most of the tower (like the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7APV9JOdJoc"]op/ragdoll skip [/url]in the main game)[/p][list][*][p]If you're unsure, feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/BBByZfQ"]check with us[/url].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If it feels like cheating, it’s probably cheating[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]What is allowed:[/h3][list][*][p]Top grabs are allowed[/p][list][*][p]We do feel that top grabs will not play a big part in this competition, which is why we are allowing top grabs[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pausing is allowed[/p][/*][*][p]You can close the game and return to it later[/p][list][*][p]Make sure we can view the entire run upon submission[/p][/*][*][p]If you find exploits from saving and loading, those are not allowed. The game must act as if you hadn't saved and quit[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]If you've beaten the tower:[/h3][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/BBByZfQ"]discord[/url] and send us a message!!! When there is a winner we'll be posting both here and in the discord[/p][p]If you don't have a discord, you can send us an email to [url="https://info@istoinc.com)"]info@istoinc.com[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]The Unofficial Leaderboard[/h3][p]I thought it would be fun to try and track some notable players. This isn't official and will be me doing my best to track some streamers attempting the tower. [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ewz40CIxnVv3WQSjiP_2y3O4PWJDq2DOw8A-8lbDZpE/edit?usp=sharing"]Feel free to take a look![/url]
[/p][p][u]The DLC launches Monday, July 14 @ 11 am MST (6 pm UTC).[/u] [/p][p]
See you there![/p][p]Stephen & The Isto Team[/p]

notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,
First and foremost, thank you to everyone for picking up the game! It means the world to us. We've been hard at work improving the game, and slowly but surely working our way through our list of highly requested improvements. 


[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
Our biggest complaint was the loading hitches when transitioning between major sections (especially for the speedrunners with slower hard drives).

[b]- Improved Level Loading[/b]
 We greatly reducing loading "hitches" when transitioning between different levels.

[b]- Steadier Camera[/b]
We fixed [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ironmouse/clip/ConcernedSuspiciousLaptopPlanking-YzMEdmPuGO3a0vCv]an issue[/url] where the character would "flicker" when on the ground. As it turns out, since the camera is set to follow the players orientation, this flickering makes the camera also feel jittery. By removing the characters jitter, the camera also feels more steady.

 
[h2]Visual Fixes[/h2]
Along with Performance, we've been making minor adjustments to the visuals

- Brightened up the colours and lights in the middle management section
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/b2803345979c06229bae0a78a9aba55b29881e46.png[/img]
-Fixed [url=https://www.twitch.tv/atrioc/clip/GleamingInterestingFalconFutureMan-lSCHHzJ-aT-al_7O]an issue[/url] where the character would flicker when in the air in the warehouse section
-Fixed interview sign (which previously said "inverview")
-Fixed the outer buildings sometimes having random black streaks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298030/9692520d9125769fa40381bfec968aee7c63e5bf.png[/img]
-Made the restaurant in Junior Financial Analyst less shiny
-Added a fog in the final secret section

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where some players (Usually for players with very low frame rates) would fall through the slingshot
- Fixed an issue where some players couldn't start the game (usually after a power outage)
- Fixed a bug where the timer would reset after it hit 24hr
- Fixed many grammar mistakes and aligned the text to match the V/O
- Fixed a bug where exiting ragdoll mode would [url=https://www.twitch.tv/atrioc/clip/ViscousHyperCookieSuperVinlin-hglXM4SiPd3bBFbU]"fling" the player randomly[/url] both up and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/linkus7/clip/SpotlessSuspiciousShrewDoritosChip-8wU7A0XG-eFUi2of?filter=clips&range=7d&sort=time]down[/url]
- Fixed the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/smallant/clip/RealJollyBorkBudBlast-mMN4fn0PYijwR1KV]OP-JumpPad skip[/url]
- Made the fall to get the free hat much steeper so players [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dougdoug/clip/TransparentCrepuscularOilTBCheesePull-rXqJSIn3Y1C7_yFq]cannot get stuck[/url]

[h2]Other Minor Changes[/h2]
- Removed the speedrun competition banner
- Reduced the noise when hitting some chairs in Middle Management

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
- I've recently started working on a video summarizing the speedrun competition.
- We may also explore upgrading our game engine to a new version to see if we can get any free performance boosts. 
- Will continue to fix minor bugs and make improvements across the game


Thanks for all of the support!
-Stephen & The Isto Team

notes.title: Hotfix - Some players couldn't start the game
notes.notes:
We added a fix for players who had their gamestate corrupted (often due to a power-outage or computer crash). 
When player's got this error, clicking "load" and "new game" wouldn't do anything.
The game will now recognize corrupted gamestates and rebuild their gamestate so players can resume their play.

notes.title: Speedrun Leg 3 Winner
notes.notes:
[h3]The story so far[/h3]
We've been holding a 10 day speedrun competition with multiple legs, each with their own prizes
[list]
[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2706170/view/537713677454803841]Leg 1[/url] had a time of 20:46 .[/b]
        Leg 1 covered the first 24 hours, and despite everyone learning the game for the first time, the winner, Kerem, emerged victorious with a time of 20:46, winning $500 CAD
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2706170/announcements/detail/533211329960346093]Leg 2 [/url] had a time of 14:50. [/b]
        Leg 2 allowed all glitches, and players took full advantage, with some wacky and wild skips and again, Kerem managed to barely clinch a victory, winning $700 CAD
[/list]

[h3]The Final Leg[/h3]
For this last run, we thought no one would get even close to 14 minutes, since it was glitchless! (which massively nerfed the run). 

This rules for this leg:
[olist]
[*]No [url=https://youtu.be/d39v4ExatPE?si=5L91Y6SlgahPapX9&t=994]out of bounds skips[/url],
[*]No [url=https://www.twitch.tv/smallant/clip/RealJollyBorkBudBlast-mMN4fn0PYijwR1KV]op-ragdoll bug skips[/url]
[*]The frame rate was limited to between 60-45fps (We did allow what is called a "top-grab" skip, which happens when you grab the top of a slingshot).

Do note that in this run, you will see players pause their game and change their frame rate. That was because they get more height on a lower frame rate on these top-grab skips. These are allowed! 
[/olist]  
And let me say, the competition was fierce. Amongst over a hundred submissions, thousands of people playing the game, it was anyone's game to win. 

[h3]And the Winner is...[/h3]
We are so excited to present to you, the winning time of 11:28 by Kerem09 
[b]Kerem has managed to win a back-to-back-to-back, three-leg sweep![/b]
Not only was it an impressive feat, but he certainly earned it, playing over 160 hours over the 10 days.

[b]SPOILER WARNING: Just remember, this video contains SPOILERS!
[/b]
[previewyoutube=oxl2tECVNeM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you to everyone who ran the game (and broke it in ways we could have never dreamed of), our discord community, and everyone who played the game.

Stephen & The Isto Team.

notes.title: Get to Work is a game that finally asks the question: 'Can you climb the corporate ladder if you have rollerblades strapped to your hands and feet?'
notes.notes: "You are poor and bald. Get to work," reads the simple description of Get to Work, a game that is a metaphor for climbing the corporate ladder that also a game where you are a guy with rollerblades on his hands and feet and little wheeled pads on his knees and elbows who can only go very fast. It also has comedy bits and a sassy narrator... Read more.

notes.title: Department Head and VP Changes
notes.notes:
We watched hours and hours of footage yesterday and wanted to rebalance the last part of the game.

[b]Gameplay/Art changes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where PointCrow's audio (in the podcast) was not playing
- Added more recovery into the VP areas
- tweaked a "brown-wood ramp" in the first VP area that required a little too much precision
- cleaned up some textures at the end of middle management
- changed the jumps at the end of middle management (the concrete ones where you recruit the youtuber) area so players wouldn't get stuck between them and the wall

[b]UI Changes[/b]
- Fixed the popup dialogue scaling incorrectly for certain screen sizes
- Updated Ui visuals for multiple levels
- Updated Settings menu for widescreen

[b]For the speedrunners[/b]
- Updated the speedrun timer to show cumulative time saves throughout the run
- Added a restart button 
- fixed save splits button being unpressable during end cutscenes
- Tweaked some load bounds to help mitigate some loading issues when going really fast
